bToA.memory: Soren noticed Leo Vance's name when checking the arrival threshold runes and Dueling Courtyard barrier logs—an unawakened Earth transfer registering an anomalous signature at Waystone Quad. He hasn't spoken to Leo yet, though he privately made note to make sure the newcomer knows when an anchor sigil is still cooling.
